bugs_found: compound_interest accepts negative principal and returns a negative future value instead of rejecting invalid money input
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), causing undeclared behavior changes for non-integer inputs
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), accepting invalid loan terms instead of rejecting them
transfer mutates account_from before mutating account_to, so a failure during the credit step can leave balances inconsistent with no rollback
fx_convert does not validate that the FX rate is positive, so zero or negative rates can silently produce invalid converted amounts
